terms.definition: A complete power‑generation unit combining a prime‑mover engine and an alternator with control and support subsystems.
The engine that drives the alternator (diesel, gas, etc.).
The AC generator end that converts mechanical power into electrical power.
Suspect Parameter Number / Failure Mode Identifier (SAE J1939).
ISO 8528 ratings: Emergency Standby / Prime / Continuous / Limited‑Time Power.
